title: 7 Marks of a Man Who Works Like God Is Actually Watching
caption:
"Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for the Lord." Colossians 3:23.

Most guys have two modes at work: the version that shows when the boss is watching, and the version that shows when he isn't. Scripture never gave you that option.

Show up early when no one's grading it. Finish the part of the job nobody sees. Do the boring task without cutting the corner. Fix your own mistake before anyone notices.

Treat Monday morning like Sunday matters. Because to Him, it always does.

#faith #workethic #discipline #colossians #godlyman
